status: prescribed model inputs; discrete Fluent verification pending

hlp_calibration.method: Linear extrapolation of the NASA calibrated BEMT performance map from 5 and 10 KEAS to zero, then similarity scaling of CT and CQ to CAD diameter and requested RPM.
hlp_calibration.table_configuration: 80-degree deployed folding HLP, standard sea-level atmosphere.
hlp_calibration.limitation: A small extrapolation of predicted near-static data. Prescribed RPM ignores HLP current and torque limiting.

cruise_calibration.method: Isolated static BEMT. CAD blade chord and geometric twist from cylinder intersections; uniform collective trim matches the published full torque command at nominal RPM. Pitch is held fixed for the sweep.
cruise_calibration.polar: NACA64_A17 surrogate at Re 750000 including its original rotational stall correction. Real MT blade polars and controller flight dynamics are unavailable. No compressibility or further Reynolds correction.
cruise_calibration.quadrature: 256 equally spaced annulus midpoints with Prandtl tip and hub losses and induced swirl.

source_terms.hub_definition: Maximum CAD spinner radius over the entire 0.05 m disk slab.
source_terms.discrete_normalization: For each grid integrate both dimensionless weight fields over fluid cell volumes to replace continuum norms. Recheck each source force and torque using Fluent reports.
source_terms.swirl_off: Hold axial thrust at the matched swirl-on value. Set tangential source to zero.
source_terms.mirrored_configuration: Starboard CAD rotation follows negative axial-to-positive-azimuth chord slope for positive-x rotation. Reflecting to port reverses axial torque. NASA reports alternating adjacent HLPs on the later simulator configuration.
